text.en: 1. This Notification may be cited as the Land Titles (Strata) (Non-Application of Section 6) (Consolidation) Notification.

2. The Minister hereby specifies that the provisions of section 6 of the Act shall not apply to the following buildings:
(a)Tanjong Pagar Complex (Lot 1074C TS 23 comprised in Certificate of Title Vol. 611 Folio 96) controlled, managed and administered by PSA Corporation Limited;
[S 187/2004 — 7.4.2004]
(b)PSA Building (Lot 2697T Mukim 1 comprised in Certificate of Title Vol. 605 Folio 151) controlled, managed and administered by Heliconia Realty Pte Ltd.
[S 188/2004 — 12.4.2004]
